Route 16 - Engine bay main routes (surgical rewire)

Status: lines redrawn 2026-11-09 (Dan Z10 b: the device spots are his, the route is the agent's - tidy straight lines, as few branches as possible, shortest possible, no double-backs); not yet reviewed by Dan. It replaces his 2026-10-21 markup of 9 lines and the 2026-10-28 device branches N1-N19 (git history keeps them). Every new engine-bay circuit of the ECU engine harness runs along one of these 5 lines (DECISIONS B9: no OEM wire crosses into the engine bay; every engine-bay circuit is new wire on one main route). The device spots are unchanged: Dan's 2026-10-28 placement and his 2026-11-09 starter move (Y7 b).

Drawn on the 1993 EWD "Electrical Wiring Routing" p.36 (3S-GTE). Best fit on factory art, not measured. Firewall at top, front at bottom, passenger (RH) side on the left. Line numbers 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 keep their old names; lines 3, 7, 8 and 9 are gone.

#NamePath
1Main trunkBulkhead (RH firewall, in the spot of the large OEM accordion grommet pass-through, near the new fuse boxes in the glove box area; Dan 2026-10-25) in one straight line along the firewall side of the head to the throttle body. The injectors, coils, knock sensor, intake air temp, MAP, coolant pressure, cam and flex fuel sensors break out of it.
2Driver-side dropFrom the trunk, just before the throttle body, straight down the transaxle end to the charge air temp sensor. Oil pressure, VSS, coolant temp, starter S, boost solenoid, reverse switch and turbo speed break out of it.
4Passenger front runFrom the first corner of line 6 past the MR-S pump (plugs B / C) to the oil temp sensor.
5Fuel pressure spurFrom the trunk, where line 2 leaves it, straight to the fuel pressure sensor on the driver-side firewall.
6Belt-end dropFrom the bulkhead straight down the passenger side, then in to the CAN-Lambda and the crank sensor at the timing-belt end.

Device spots and breakouts (spots: Dan, 2026-10-28; breakouts: 2026-11-09 redraw)

The one definition of where each engine-bay device of the ECU engine harness sits and which line it hangs on. Spots placed by Dan in the placement editor on the same EWD page; the layout tree and wire lengths are made from this table. Each device breaks out of its line at the nearest point: map length x 5.3 mm per EWD point, at least 6 in (152 mm) for a connector part-way along a line, plus a 300 mm drop for a low part (DECISIONS B8); a device that ends its line has no breakout (0). MR-S pump plugs B / C (24 / 25) carry harness C circuits that ride this loom from the bulkhead; plug A (power) is harness C at the same pump. L1, L2, L4, L5, L6 = routes 1, 2, 4, 5, 6; there are no device branches.

Moved to Route 1 (Dan B6 b, 2026-11-02): H1, H2, H4 and the block ground stud (18) belong to HeavyDC's own map; they stay listed here for reference only (not drawn) and the engine harness tree does not use them.
